'''Kuwemaki''' is an independent system in the Core Systems, reached by Commanders pursuing '''[[Hera Tani]]''''s power-systems Engineering after a referral from [[Liz Ryder]]. It hosts '''[[The Jet's Hole]]''', Hera's workshop.<ref name="inara-kuwemaki">[https://inara.cz/elite/starsystem/15367/ Kuwemaki — Star System], Inara.</ref>

== Overview ==

* '''Star:''' Class K (scoopable)
* '''Allegiance:''' Independent
* '''Government:''' Corporate
* '''Security:''' Medium
* '''Economy:''' Extraction / High Tech<ref name="inara-kuwemaki" />

== Engineer Facility ==

'''[[The Jet's Hole]]''' is a surface Engineer base on Kuwemaki A 3 a, operated by '''[[Hera Tani]]'''.<ref name="inara-jets-hole">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/52289/ The Jet's Hole in Kuwemaki — Station], Inara.</ref>

No system permit is required to enter Kuwemaki. See [[Hera Tani]] for the full discovery, invitation, and unlock requirements for her workshop.
